model: 600 in-house model — district/state presidential lean + poll fundamentals, correlated Monte Carlo

environment.margin_method: Senate: state presidential lean + elasticity-scaled environment + incumbency/trend. House: district presidential lean (The Downballot, 2026 lines) + last result + rating band, with the generic-ballot House vote bias corrected. Governor: 50/50 current/prior state presidential lean + rating band + incumbency. Polls rebuilt from individual surveys with recency, partisan, sample-size and population weights, a firm cap, one survey per pollster, an RV-to-LV shift, pollster ratings, house effects and an outlier guard.
